Method of Attack: Data leakage via maliciously crafted PDF documents that call home and send victim's NTLM hash to remote attackers in the form of an SMB request
Bypass of zero-day patch leading to sensitive information disclosure in Adobe Acrobat and Reader
Impacted Systems: Adobe Acrobat Reader DC up to 19.010.20069 on Windows and macOS
Attack Vector: Malicious PDF documents exploiting SMB requests to exfiltrate NTLM hashes
